nodes.label: Unsure reply still opens deal
nodes.rationale: If readers disagree on a deal, open it flagged 'Needs you' rather than dropping the email.

nodes.label: Contract filing
nodes.rationale: Any agreement or contract PDF sent by a brand must be filed to CONTRACTS and the deal, regardless of email text.

nodes.label: Agency contact pitching new product
nodes.rationale: A contact pitching a different product or campaign is a new lead/deal, not a reply to an old deal.
